title: 2020 HMMT November Guts Problem 6
statement: If \(x, y, z\) are real numbers such that \(x y=6, x-z=2\), and \(x+y+z=9\), compute \(\frac{x}{y}-\frac{z}{x}-\frac{z^{2}}{x y}\). Proposed by: Ragulan Sivakumar

solutions.text:
Let \(k=\frac{x}{y}-\frac{z}{x}-\frac{z^{2}}{x y}=\frac{x^{2}-y z-z^{2}}{x y}\). We have

\[k+1=\frac{x^{2}+x y-y z-z^{2}}{x y}=\frac{x^{2}-x z+x y-y z+z x-z^{2}}{x y}=\frac{(x+y+z)(x-z)}{x y}=\frac{9 \cdot 2}{6}=3,\]

so \(k=2\).
